payload.explanation: The business UPDATE on inventory (product_id=1) is blocked waiting on a transactionid lock held by session_29de86c9feae, which is idle in transaction (waiting on ClientRead) after running the same UPDATE. The blocker holds an uncommitted row lock; rolling back that eligible owned session would release the lock and let the business request proceed. Other idle-in-transaction sessions (session_de59c75ce72b, session_e2f562616f57) only ran SELECT 1 and are not blocking. No evidence of large data, index, or vacuum issues (single-row PK table, one UPDATE call). Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed via pg_blocking_pids.
